key_impacts: Government inquiries into the 2011 Queensland floods led to recommendations for major changes in flood insurance, early warning systems, emergency management planning, land use planning and reconstruction.

Government inquiries into the 2010/11 Victoria floods led to recommendations for major changes in flood insurance, early warning systems, emergency management planning, land use planning and reconstruction.
Prompted a national inquiry considering diversion of more funding to risk reduction, including for flooding.
Could significantly challenge countries’ emergency management capacities and slow socio-economic recovery.
